name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2610: REG-589 and A11. The heart reported 8 DARK vessels, all with the same sentence - it runs and NOTHING watches it. Measured on his tree - SIX of those eight ARE the supervisors: _bridge_prober, _console_beacon_loop, _console_rescue_loop, _mini_watchdog, _orphan_exit_loop, _orphan_watch. Only TWO are ordinary work nobody watches - _engine_driver and _kai_closer_loop. Nothing watches the watchman is not the same fault as nothing watches this worker. Every supervision tree has an unsupervised root, so that is structural, and answering it needs a DIFFERENT mechanism - a peer, a heartbeat file, a second process - not the watcher the other DARK rows are waiting for. Reported as eight identical gaps, six of them send a reader to build something that would not help. The supervisor set is QUOTED from lane_census, which owns it and has the guard that keeps it honest, rather than copied. And a census that cannot answer whether a lane supervises says so instead of defaulting to not-a-supervisor. Proven RED by collapsing the distinction - three cases fail including the baseline that the two messages differ.
